source_locators.fact: Driver binds seven named C exports with opaque instance-pointer ABI; no exposed instance struct or state getter.

Complete command dispatch has no inspect/read-memory/dump-coefficient command; unknown commands die. This is a driver-interface statement, not a claim no possible original export/API exists.

Loader/binding declarations return loaded export addresses/import diagnostics; they are not a script-accessible state reader.

not_a_state_route: Output audio is not a memory snapshot. A finite noisy/quantized multicomponent vector does not uniquely identify every private rounded denominator/state without further model/observability/error assumptions.
--imports/used/ret/flag/hostparameter echoes and optional formatting traces are not proven a1/a2/current-slot outputs. No unsupported command/selector is proposed as a workaround.
Readiness is historical source/file inspection; successful prior captures do not upgrade absent state-interface capability. No new loader/version/help/compiler/dependency probe ran.

minimum_observer_design_not_code.principle: One fixed Corpus-specific read-only sidecar observer in a NEW analyst driver binary; leave original bundle and existing loader/binder/CXX providers unchanged. No originalcode patch, privateoriginalfunction call, fakehost, newhook, genericaddress/count CLI or broad memorydump. This is not independent application implementation.

Start only from existing0x29c0/0x23b0 loglocators if Root selects that source task. Arm64M offsets/classnames and successful readable addresses alone are inadmissible substitutes.
fixed_payload_after_that_proof: Raw u32 hex bytes for same selected slotk (initial targetk=1), its actual ratio word, numerator/pickup factors, a1/a2 and recurrence state cells; record actual selected processingidentity, requested/retainedcount and branch/lane predicates sufficient to admit that slot. Do not assume every selectednode or bothchannels share a bank.

Separate raw flag/coefficients/state for the guarded local outputrecurrence identified in full C; preserve its distinction from per-k banks. Read only field ranges whose x86 identity/allocation has been independently established.

Record count/path/quality facts as actual readouts with rawbytes. Unknown pointers/type/slot/count/bounds yield an inconclusive stop, not speculative reads. Sorted m/n labels live in source local scratch and are not automatically available at a post-process boundary; no inferred pairlabel from slotindex/R>1.

minimum_observer_design_not_code.snapshot_timing: Initial narrow proposal: copy fixed fieldbytes after already-existing blocks ending at hostframe4608 and16384, while instancealive. These are harnessboundary labels, not Liveframebase. Two equal boundaryrecords do NOT prove coefficientstationarity throughout a block/window; source/path proof or further separately selected observation is still required.

minimum_observer_design_not_code.build_boundary: No source/binary was modified or compiled here. A proposed new driver/source/delta/build identity and installed-toolchain capability require Root selection and independent preflight; never overwrite xdev or invoke old build/main. No installation is proposed.
unknowns_preserved: Actual x86 object/field/lane identities and admission remain the immediate prerequisite; no direct runtime observer capability is currently demonstrated.
A snapshot establishes words at its readout instant only. It does not retroactively inspect original historical006 state or prove intrablock invariance.
Capture of a1/a2 would still be originalx86-under-substitutions state, not Applelibm/arm64/application coefficients.

pole_and_observability_requirements.actual_readout_needed: Use actual stored rounded same-slot words, with proven recurrence sign/slot/lane and actualfs/state; never nominalfrequency, unrounded designvalues or ARM offsets guessed in x86.
pole_and_observability_requirements.no_pole_method_executed: Only after data admission may a separately reviewed method derive a pole with justified numerical precision/error treatment. No tolerance/CI/criterion is adopted here.
pole_and_observability_requirements.audible_component_is_separate: A denominator pole does not identify zero-based measuredmode1 without an actual coefficient-stationary interval, nonzero relevant residue/productive input and outputpath, no cancellation/alias/misassignment, and account of the guarded extra recurrence and per-channel mixing. Flags/labels/counts are not proof of sound.
pole_and_observability_requirements.unchanged_omissions: All174historical and2note72mode16 omissions remainU; source/state work does not create a graded waveform/modal case.

alternative_if_state_layout_is_not_ready.capability: Unchanged driver already delivers audio under exactscripts, so an output-only path remains possible; it would measure a physicalcomponent, not internal rounded words. It is not selected and no additionalcapture is proposed simply to increase casecounts.
minimum_calibration_needed: A prespecified fullrate or alias-controlled observation with an independently justified component/order/stationarity model and explicit treatment of extra recurrence, unknown residues and close/weak nuisance components.

Independent known-pole controls covering actual difficulty, model-order/window/rank/quantization and import/numerical effects; negative controls must reject the identified wrong/aliased component, not just reproduce the same fitted model.
A calibrated error or bound justified beyond finite estimator spread/perturbation experiments; no CI from spread, no transferred sineHz/Ramp1%/pickup1% budget.

If retainedduration/information is insufficient, identify the exact duration/SNR/input dependency before selecting one newcapture; longer decay data may worsenSNR. The prior bounded calibration was inconclusive, not proof no estimator can work.
alternative_if_state_layout_is_not_ready.limit: No estimator/model/function/comparator or numerical diagnostic was imported/run here; this alternative does not assert current feasibility or a gradedfrequency result.
